image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a reusable cloth diaper (nappy). The main body is made of a soft, white, fleece-like material. It features blue patterned fabric trim along the top waistband and side leg openings. Yellow elastic loops or snaps are visible on the sides. A small red and black tag with text/logo is sewn into the lower-left front panel. The diaper appears bulky and padded.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the white fabric is slightly uniform and 'smudged' in areas, lacking the distinct individual fiber definition expected in a macro shot of fleece. It resembles AI-generated noise or over-smoothing.
The yellow elastic loops on the left and right sides appear physically ambiguous. They seem to float or merge into the blue trim without a clear anchor point or realistic tension physics.
The text on the red tag is illegible and distorted, appearing as abstract shapes rather than coherent characters, a common artifact in AI generation.
